glb_path.tooltip: estimator mesh GLB path — wire AnnySelectPerson.glb_path

params_json.tooltip: Canonical preset params (the presets door row verbatim — never hand-edited).

ApplyTextureToMesh.description: Attaches baked texture IMAGEs to a mesh's UV layout for SaveGLB. Feed the SAME mesh you baked
ApplyTextureToMesh.name: ApplyTextureToMesh

BakeAmbientOcclusion.description: Bakes an ambient-occlusion map from a high-poly mesh into a low-poly's UV layout (white = open, dark = crevices). Feed the UV-unwrapped low_poly and the high_poly it was decimated from. Outputs a grayscale image for Apply Texture To Mesh's occlusion input (packed into the ORM map / occlusionTexture).

bias.tooltip: Ray origin lift off the surface, as a fraction of the bounding box diagonal. Raise if even surfaces show dark blotches/holes.

max_distance.tooltip: Ray length, as a fraction of the bounding box diagonal. Smaller = tighter, more local occlusion.

samples.tooltip: Rays per texel. More = smoother, slower. Raise if grainy.

BakeAmbientOcclusion.name: BakeAmbientOcclusion

BakeNormalMapFromMesh.description: Bakes a tangent-space normal map (glTF/OpenGL +Y) from a high-poly mesh into a low-poly's UV layout, capturing detail lost during decimation. Feed the UV-unwrapped low_poly and the high_poly it was decimated from. Outputs an image for Apply Texture To Mesh's normal_map input.

cage_distance.tooltip: Surface search band, as a fraction of the bounding box diagonal. Raise for wrong/missing patches under heavy decimation; lower if it grabs across gaps.

ignore_backfaces.tooltip: Skip high-poly surfaces facing away from the texel, so crevices/enclosed spaces don't grab the opposite wall. Disable only if the high-poly winding is inconsistent.

BakeNormalMapFromMesh.name: BakeNormalMapFromMesh

BakeTextureFromVoxel.description: Bakes PBR textures onto the mesh's existing UV layout (trilinear-sample the sparse voxel volume). Does NOT unwrap — connect a UV unwrap node upstream. Outputs base_color + metallic/roughness grayscale IMAGEs (black if no PBR); feed them to ApplyTextureToMesh (SAME mesh) for SaveGLB.

reference_mesh.tooltip: Optional dense pre-decimation mesh; back-projects each texel onto its true surface before sampling, removing faceted baking on coarse meshes.

BakeTextureFromVoxel.name: BakeTextureFromVoxel

CFGOverride.description: Override cfg to a fixed value over a [start, end] percent (sigma) range. With multiple overrides, the one nearest the sampler wins on overlap.
CFGOverride.name: CFGOverride

CLIPLoader.description:
Recipes:
sd: clip-l
stable cascade: clip-g
sd3: t5 xxl / clip-g / clip-l
stable audio: t5 base
mochi: t5 xxl
cogvideox: t5 xxl (226-token padding)
cosmos: old t5 xxl
lumina2: gemma 2 2B
wan: umt5 xxl
hidream: llama-3.1 (Recommend) or t5
omnigen2: qwen vl 2.5 3B
joyimage: qwen3-vl 8B
lens: gpt-oss-20b
pixeldit: gemma 2 2B elm
minimax: MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL or Music3 Qwen/RVQ
CLIPLoader.name: CLIPLoader

CLIPTextEncode.description: Encodes a text prompt using a CLIP model into an embedding that can be used to guide the diffusion model towards generating specific images.

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.

CLIPTextEncode.name: CLIPTextEncode
output_tooltips: A conditioning containing the embedded text used to guide the diffusion model.

DecimateMesh.description: Simplifies a mesh to a target face count using QEM, on the active compute device. 'midpoint' is the cumesh-faithful preset (best quality, preserves thin features / hair); 'qem' places vertices at the QEM optimum with line/feature-edge controls. Output stays welded.

clamp_v_to_edge.tooltip: Project the QEM-optimal position onto the collapsed edge segment.

feature_edge_min_dihedral_deg.tooltip: Minimum dihedral angle (degree) to count an edge as a feature edge.

feature_edge_quadric_weight.tooltip: Extra quadric weight on dihedral feature edges (creases). 0 = off.

line_quadric_weight.tooltip: Per-edge line-quadric weight; preserves sharp ridges/valleys. 0 = off.

DecimateMesh.name: DecimateMesh

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent images in the batch.

FitProp.display_name: Fit Prop (seat a static prop onto a SOMAX body)
FitProp.name: FitProp

FitRow.display_name: Fit Row (assemble the meld attachment row from knobs)
FitRow.name: FitRow

background.tooltip: Background color behind the masked subject.

grow_mask.tooltip: Grow or shrink the mask by this many pixels before cropping.

pad_factor.tooltip: Extra margin around the mask bounding box as a multiplier.

KSampler.description: Uses the provided model, positive and negative conditioning to denoise the latent image.

cfg.tooltip: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

model.tooltip: The model used for denoising the input latent.

negative.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

positive.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

sampler_name.tooltip: The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.

scheduler.tooltip: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

steps.tooltip: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

KSampler.name: KSampler

decimate_ratio.tooltip: Mesh decimation ratio (0=off, 0.2=reduce to 20%% of faces). Uses Collapse mode which preserves skin weights. Reduces file size ~70%%.

in_place.tooltip: In-place motion: zero root horizontal drift so character walks on a treadmill (stays centered). Recommended for Pose Studio.

npz_path.tooltip: Optional: SOMA-77 motion NPZ for retargeting. If provided, Blender retargets motion onto the character. If empty, just converts format.

preserve_texture.tooltip: SOMAX standalone mode only. When True (default), the output GLB keeps the source mesh's textures. When False, all textures are stripped and the mesh is given a flat SOMA-blue material — useful when you want to apply textures later in Pose Studio or an external tool. Ignored for retarget.

source_glb.tooltip: Optional: original textured GLB. When provided (and no npz_path), GPU transfers the rig + skin weights from rigged_path onto THIS mesh, preserving textures. Uses AABB-aligned torch.cdist nearest-neighbor on the RTX 4090 (~10s for 500K verts) and writes the GLB directly — no Blender involved.

file_format.tooltip: FBX for Unity/Unreal/Kimodo. GLB for web/Three.js.

rigged_path.tooltip: Path to a rigged GLB/FBX with Mixamo bone names. Connect from SaveRiggedModel or provide a path.

bg_removal_name.tooltip: The model used to remove backgrounds from images

MeshSmoothNormals.description: Compute smooth per-vertex normals and attach them to the mesh. Meshes without normals are shaded flat (per-face) by glTF viewers; this makes them shade smoothly. With crease_angle below 180, edges sharper than the threshold are kept hard by splitting vertices along them.

crease_angle.tooltip: Edges whose dihedral angle exceeds this value (degrees) stay hard (vertices are split). 180 = fully smooth; lower preserves sharp edges (e.g. ~30-60 for hard-surface).

MeshSmoothNormals.name: MeshSmoothNormals

MeshToFile3D.description: Serialize a mesh to a GLB File3D object for Save / Preview 3D nodes, carrying its UVs, colors, normals, texture, normal/occlusion/emissive maps and material. Supports one item per batch only.
MeshToFile3D.name: MeshToFile3D

MoGeGeometryToFOV.description: Derive the field of view and focal length from MoGe intrinsics.
MoGeGeometryToFOV.name: MoGeGeometryToFOV

MoGeInference.description: Run MoGe on a single image to estimate depth and geometry.

apply_mask.tooltip: Set masked-out (sky / invalid) pixels to inf in points and depth so meshing culls them. Disable to keep the raw predicted geometry everywhere; the mask is still returned separately.

batch_size.tooltip: Images per inference call. Lower if you OOM on a long video / image set.

fov_x_degrees.tooltip: Horizontal field of view of the source camera. Sets the focal length used to unproject the depth map into 3D. 0 = auto-recover from the predicted points.

MoGeInference.name: MoGeInference

checkpoint.tooltip: multihmr2.pt path — defaults to MULTIHMR2_CKPT env > models dir

image_path.tooltip: Path to an image file (used when no tensor is wired)

conf_thresh.tooltip: Minimum confidence to keep a person

render.tooltip: Overlay render (needs the multihmr2 render extras: pyrender)

camera_angle_x.tooltip: Horizontal FOV in degrees. Wire a MoGeGeometryToFOV (axis='horizontal', unit='degrees') for a per-image FoV (matches upstream default).

image.tooltip: Preprocessed image from ImageCropToMask (pad_factor=1.1 for Pixal3D).

glb_path.tooltip: GLB to render (filename in input/ or output/, or absolute path).

RemeshMesh.description: Re-extracts a uniformly tessellated mesh via a narrow-band distance field + Dual Contouring, on the active compute device. Normalizes messy / non-manifold / self-intersecting topology; run before Decimate Mesh to hit an exact face count. Output stays welded.

band.tooltip: Narrow-band width in voxel units. In UDF mode also offsets the surface.

drop_small_components.tooltip: Drop components below this fraction of the largest's face count. 0 disables.

fix_poles.tooltip: Collapse valence-3 vertex pairs (DC T-junction artifact).

precluster_max_verts.tooltip: Cap input vertex count before the field queries, inputs above this are cluster-decimated to it first. Prevents OOM on huge meshes.

project_back.tooltip: Linearly interpolate vertices toward the original surface (0 = pure DC, 1 = snapped).

resolution.tooltip: Voxel grid resolution (output density). 256 ~ 100k faces, 512 ~ 1M. For an exact face count, follow with Decimate Mesh.

drop_enclosed_components.tooltip: Drop components inside the largest's bbox that fail a point-in-mesh raycast. Disable for legitimate nested parts.

drop_inverted_components.tooltip: Drop inward-normal (negative-volume) closed components — the UDF inner shell.

qef.tooltip: QEF (Quadratic Error Function) dual-vertex placement for sharper edges.

manifold.tooltip: Manifold Dual Contouring: 1-4 dual verts/voxel for multi-sheet cases. Slower.

qef.tooltip: QEF (Quadratic Error Function) dual-vertex placement (recovers sharp features) vs edge-crossing centroid.

sign_mode.tooltip: udf: robust to messy/non-manifold input. sdf: clean single surface with QEF (Quadratic Error Function) sharp-feature recovery, but needs consistent winding.

smooth_iters.tooltip: Taubin smoothing iterations (0 = off). 2-3 cleans DC staircase-like artifacts; higher over-smooth QEF edges.

RemeshMesh.name: RemeshMesh

RemoveBackground.description: Generates a foreground mask to remove the background from an image using a background removal model.

bg_removal_model.tooltip: Background removal model used to generate the mask

image.tooltip: Input image to remove the background from

RemoveBackground.name: RemoveBackground

image_path.tooltip: Direct photo path (overrides the tensor; no recompression)

model_3d.tooltip: 3D model file from an upstream 3D node.

SaveImage.description: Saves the input images to your ComfyUI output directory.

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. This may include formatting information such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd% or %Empty Latent Image.width% to include values from nodes.

SaveImage.name: SaveImage

SaveText.description: Save text content to a file in the output directory.
SaveText.name: SaveText

SeedVR2LoadDiTModel.description:
Load and configure SeedVR2 DiT (Diffusion Transformer) model for video upscaling. Supports BlockSwap memory optimization for low VRAM systems, model caching for batch processing, multi-GPU offloading, and torch.compile acceleration. 

Connect to Video Upscaler node.

attention_mode.tooltip:
Attention computation backend:
• sdpa: PyTorch scaled_dot_product_attention (default, stable, always available)
• flash_attn_2: Flash Attention 2 (Ampere+, requires flash-attn package)
• flash_attn_3: Flash Attention 3 (Hopper+, requires flash-attn with FA3 support)
• sageattn_2: SageAttention 2 (requires sageattention package)
• sageattn_3: SageAttention 3 (Blackwell/RTX 50xx only, requires sageattn3 package)

SDPA is recommended - stable and works everywhere.
Flash Attention and SageAttention provide speedup through optimized CUDA kernels on compatible GPUs.

blocks_to_swap.tooltip:
Number of transformer blocks to swap between devices for VRAM optimization.
• 0: Disabled (default)
• 3B model: 0-32 blocks
• 7B model: 0-36 blocks

Requires offload_device to be set and different from device.
Not available on macOS (unified memory architecture).

cache_model.tooltip:
Keep DiT model loaded on offload_device between workflow runs.
Useful for batch processing to avoid repeated loading.
Requires offload_device to be set.

offload_device.tooltip:
Device to offload DiT model when not actively processing.
• 'none': Keep model on inference device (default, fastest)
• 'cpu': Offload to system RAM (reduces VRAM usage)
• 'cuda:X': Offload to another GPU (good balance if available)

Required for BlockSwap (blocks_to_swap or swap_io_components).

swap_io_components.tooltip:
Offload input/output embeddings and normalization layers to reduce VRAM.
Requires offload_device to be set and different from device.
Not available on macOS (unified memory architecture).

torch_compile_args.tooltip:
Optional torch.compile optimization settings from SeedVR2 Torch Compile Settings node.
Provides 20-40% speedup with compatible PyTorch 2.0+ and Triton installation.

device.tooltip: GPU device for DiT model inference (upscaling phase)

model.tooltip:
DiT (Diffusion Transformer) model for video upscaling.
Models automatically download on first use.
Additional models can be added to the ComfyUI models folder.

SeedVR2LoadDiTModel.name: SeedVR2LoadDiTModel
output_tooltips: DiT model configuration containing model path, device settings, BlockSwap parameters, and compilation options. Connect to Video Upscaler node.

SeedVR2LoadVAEModel.description:
Load and configure SeedVR2 VAE (Variational Autoencoder) for encoding/decoding video frames to/from latent space. Supports tiled processing to handle high resolutions on limited VRAM, model caching, multi-GPU offloading, and torch.compile acceleration. 

Connect to Video Upscaler node.

cache_model.tooltip:
Keep VAE model loaded on offload_device between workflow runs.
Useful for batch processing to avoid repeated loading.
Requires offload_device to be set.

decode_tile_overlap.tooltip:
Pixel overlap between decoding tiles (default: 128).
Reduces visible seams between tiles through blending.
Higher values improve quality but slow processing.
Only used when decode_tiled is enabled.

decode_tile_size.tooltip:
Decoding tile size in pixels (default: 1024).
Applied to both height and width.
Lower values reduce VRAM usage but may increase processing time.
Only used when decode_tiled is enabled.

decode_tiled.tooltip: Enable tiled decoding to reduce VRAM usage during the decoding phase

encode_tile_overlap.tooltip:
Pixel overlap between encoding tiles (default: 128).
Reduces visible seams between tiles through blending.
Higher values improve quality but slow processing.
Only used when encode_tiled is enabled.

encode_tile_size.tooltip:
Encoding tile size in pixels (default: 1024).
Applied to both height and width.
Lower values reduce VRAM usage but may increase processing time.
Only used when encode_tiled is enabled.

encode_tiled.tooltip: Enable tiled encoding to reduce VRAM usage during the encoding phase

offload_device.tooltip:
Device to offload VAE model when not actively processing.
• 'none': Keep model on inference device (default, fastest)
• 'cpu': Offload to system RAM (reduces VRAM usage)
• 'cuda:X': Offload to another GPU (good balance if available)

tile_debug.tooltip:
Tile debug visualization mode:
• 'false': No visualization overlay (default)
• 'encode': Show encoding tile boundaries
• 'decode': Show decoding tile boundaries

Only works when respective tiling is enabled.

torch_compile_args.tooltip:
Optional torch.compile optimization settings from SeedVR2 Torch Compile Settings node.
Provides 15-25% speedup with compatible PyTorch 2.0+ and Triton installation.

device.tooltip: GPU device for VAE model inference (encoding/decoding phases)

model.tooltip:
VAE (Variational Autoencoder) model for encoding/decoding.
Models automatically download on first use.
Additional models can be added to the ComfyUI models folder.

SeedVR2LoadVAEModel.name: SeedVR2LoadVAEModel
output_tooltips: VAE model configuration containing model path, device settings, tiling parameters, and compilation options. Connect to Video Upscaler node.

SeedVR2VideoUpscaler.description:
SeedVR2 main upscaling node: processes video frames using DiT and VAE models with diffusion-based enhancement. Handles RGB/RGBA formats, maintains temporal consistency across frames, applies color correction, and manages VRAM through intelligent tensor offloading. 

Requires DiT and VAE model configurations.

enable_debug.tooltip:
Enable detailed debug logging (default: False).
Shows memory usage, timing information, and processing details.
Useful for troubleshooting errors and performance issues.

input_noise_scale.tooltip:
Input noise injection scale (default: 0.0, disabled).
Adds controlled variation to input images before encoding.
Range: 0.0 (no noise) to 1.0 (maximum noise).
Can help with certain types of artifacts.

latent_noise_scale.tooltip:
Latent space noise injection scale (default: 0.0, disabled).
Adds controlled variation during the diffusion process.
Range: 0.0 (no noise) to 1.0 (maximum noise).
Can soften details if input_noise_scale doesn't help.

offload_device.tooltip:
Device for storing intermediate tensors between processing phases (default: cpu).
• 'none': Keep all tensors on inference device (fastest but highest VRAM usage)
• 'cpu': Offload to system RAM (recommended for long videos, slower transfers)
• 'cuda:X': Offload to another GPU (good balance if available, faster than CPU)

prepend_frames.tooltip:
Number of frames to prepend (reversed from start) before processing (default: 0).
Helps reduce artifacts at video beginning.
Prepended frames are automatically removed from final output.

temporal_overlap.tooltip:
Overlapping frames between consecutive batches (default: 0, disabled).
Improves temporal consistency across batch boundaries through blending.
Values 1-4 work well for most content.

batch_size.tooltip:
Number of frames processed together per batch (default: 5).
Must follow pattern 4n+1: 1, 5, 9, 13, 17, 21, ...

• Higher values: Better temporal consistency and faster processing
• Lower values: Reduced VRAM usage

Ideally match to shot length for best quality.

color_correction.tooltip:
Corrects color shifts in upscaled output to match original input (default: lab).
The upscaling process may alter colors; this applies color grading to restore them.

• lab: Perceptual color matching with detail preservation (recommended)
• wavelet: Frequency-based natural colors, preserves fine details
• wavelet_adaptive: Wavelet base with targeted saturation correction
• hsv: Hue-conditional saturation matching
• adain: Statistical style transfer approach
• none: No color correction applied

dit.tooltip: DiT model configuration from SeedVR2 (Down)Load DiT Model node

image.tooltip:
Input video frames as image batch.
Accepts both RGB (3-channel) and RGBA (4-channel) formats.
Output format will match input format.

max_resolution.tooltip:
Maximum resolution limit for any dimension (default: 0, no limit).
If any edge exceeds this after applying resolution,
both dimensions are scaled down proportionally.
Useful to prevent excessive VRAM usage on extreme aspect ratios.

resolution.tooltip:
Target resolution for the shortest edge in pixels (default: 1080).
Automatically maintains aspect ratio of input.
Even values required for optimal processing.

seed.tooltip:
Random seed for reproducible generation (default: 42).
Same seed with same inputs produces identical output.

uniform_batch_size.tooltip:
Pad final batch to match batch_size (default: False).
Prevents temporal artifacts caused by small final batch.
Add extra compute but recommended for optimal quality.

vae.tooltip: VAE model configuration from SeedVR2 (Down)Load VAE Model node

SeedVR2VideoUpscaler.name: SeedVR2VideoUpscaler
output_tooltips: Upscaled video frames with color correction applied. Format (RGB/RGBA) matches input. Range [0, 1] normalized for ComfyUI compatibility.

SkinApply.display_name: Skin Apply (attach detail maps to a SOMAX body)
SkinApply.name: SkinApply

SkinSidecar.display_name: Skin Sidecar (controller sidecar from kind knobs)
SkinSidecar.name: SkinSidecar

shape_latent.tooltip: The 512-resolution shape latent output from the first shape-stage KSampler.

target_resolution.tooltip: Voxel resolution of the upsampled shape. Higher = more detail, more VRAM.

UnwrapMesh.description: Generates a UV atlas: segments the surface into charts, parameterizes each, packs into a [0,1] atlas. Vertices on chart seams are duplicated (one copy per chart, same position, own UV), so the output mesh has more vertices than the input. Run after Remesh/Decimate, before texture baking.

resolution.tooltip: Target atlas resolution for texel-density auto-scale (0 = fit-to-content).

segmenter.tooltip: pec: fast parallel-edge-collapse charting on GPU. adaptive: CPU, slower.

weld_distance.tooltip: Coincident-vert merge radius as a fraction of mesh extent (0 = auto). Raise to ~0.001 if you get per-triangle charts (unwelded input).

UnwrapMesh.name: UnwrapMesh

VAEDecode.description: Decodes latent images back into pixel space images.

vae.tooltip: The VAE model used for decoding the latent.

VAEDecode.name: VAEDecode

shape_subdivides.tooltip: Shape information used to guide higher-detail reconstruction during decoding. Helps preserve structure consistency at higher resolutions.
